verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is local inference software. The project documents several self-hosting paths: building from source, pre-built release binaries, Docker, and Winget. It also ships `llama serve` with a built-in web UI. Community users independently confirm running it on their own Mac and x86 hardware, with one describing it as 'very nice for something self-hosted.' Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the open-source license terms, and the minor macOS quarantine friction one user hit with the release binaries.
